observations: Slate courses follow the swept mansard and lower gables without visible tile overshoot or perforated cast shadows.
Previously corrected tall-window and outer side-window clearances remain intact.
Fish crest, paired lanterns, door hardware and noticeboard establish a readable guild entrance.
Noticeboard, barrels and rope runs stay beside the central approach; the door and descending stair remain unobstructed.
Staggered precinct masonry replaces the inconsistent exposed foundation texture and reads continuously across visible corners.
The four world views retain cottage separation and coastal support from the accepted assembly macro; no new visible collision is introduced.
meaningfulTargetGaps: Masonry and slate remain very regular, with cleaner surfaces and less weathering than the inferred generated goal.
The fish crest is a simplified emblem and the crown has a simple flat cap and posts.
The retained elevated precinct is taller and visually heavier than the inferred goal's low terrace.
limits: Approval covers this compact game asset and its visible assembly, not exact parity with the inferred generated target.
Runtime behavior, render budgets and automated validators were not independently tested in this pixel review.
